hero.title: Your money, explained every morning.
hero.sub: A daily WhatsApp briefing personalised from your financial profile, not just market news.

problem.title: You earn money, but how do you know your decisions are right?

cards.d: Salary in, instalments out, savings so-so. You are not sure your money priorities are in the right order.
Plenty of info and opinions online, but nobody explains which ones matter for your situation.
Buying a home, retirement, a child's education. The stakes are high and you want clarity first.

how.title: Three steps, from form to WhatsApp.

steps.d: A multi-step form with 6 sections and a clear progress bar.
You receive a Risk Profile and Financial Ladder Level from transparent rules.
Every morning, a personal summary lands in your WhatsApp.

wizard.q: Do you have any high-interest debt?

ladder.title: One ladder, one priority at a time.
ladder.sub: Click or hover a step to see its priority.

levels.d: Sized to your type of employment.
Credit cards, paylater and online loans.
Begin with simple instruments that fit your Risk Profile.
Prepare your assets for the long term.

briefing.title: One morning message. Relevant to you.

features.d: Every briefing starts from where you are on the Financial Ladder, so the next step is always one you can take.

features.t: Tailored to the assets you hold
features.d: News and market moves are filtered to your holdings, not the whole market.
Explanations and suggestions respect how much risk you are comfortable with.
A short alert lands in WhatsApp when something you own moves more than 3% in a day.

chat.greeting: Good morning, Dinda. Here is today's briefing.
chat.news: Relevant news: The central bank is discussing the interest-rate path. This may affect deposit rates and money-market funds you hold.
chat.macro: Indicator: BI Rate and inflation are tracked. We explain the impact if anything changes.
chat.action: Small action today: set aside money for your emergency fund (Level 1) per your monthly plan.
chat.alert: Alert: an asset you hold moved more than 3% today.
chat.user: Why am I still on Level 1?
chat.reply: Your emergency fund covers 2 months of expenses. The rule engine sets your target at 6 months for contract work, so this stays your priority.
chat.cardBody: An asset you hold moved more than 3% today. Open the app for the full explanation.

ai.title: Rules decide, AI explains.
ai.body: Numbers and financial decisions come only from an auditable rule engine. AI only explains them in human language.
bullets: Audit trail: every decision traces back to its rule.
Consistency check: AI explanations are matched against rule-engine output.
No silent penalties: no score drops without an explanation.
ai.demo: Your emergency fund is currently 2 months of expenses. The rule engine sets your target at 6 months because you are on a contract, so this month's priority stays Level 1.

risk.title: Ability and willingness to take risk are two different things.
risk.body: We assess capacity (how much risk your finances can bear) and willingness (how comfortable you are with swings), then combine them.
risk.note: Adapted from Grable-Lytton, not a validated psychometric instrument.
